description.zh: 需导入ECS实例的目标集群ID。
description.en: The ID of the cluster into which you want to import ECS instances.

description.zh: 要导入集群的ECS实例ID，多个ECS实例请用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The ID of the ECS instance that you want to import into the cluster. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh: 要导入集群的ECS实例的登录密码。
description.en: The logon password of the ECS instance that you want to import into the cluster.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明

调用该接口导入ECS实例时，会重装ECS实例的操作系统，重装后，实例中所有数据都会被删除并且需要重新设置实例登录密码。请确保您要导入的ECS实例上没有重要的数据或数据已备份。

> 本接口已不推荐使用，建议使用InstallAgent接口代替，详情请参见[InstallAgent](~~127023~~)。
descriptions.en:
##

If you call this operation to import an ECS instance, the operating system of the ECS instance is reinstalled. After the operating system is reinstalled, all original data of the ECS instance is deleted. In addition, you must set a logon password for the ECS instance. Make sure that no important data exists on the ECS instance that you want to import or data has been backed up for the ECS instance.

> We recommend that you call the InstallAgent operation instead of this operation. For more information, see [InstallAgent](~~127023~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas insert-cluster-member --cluster-id b3e3f77b-462e-0000-0000-bec8727a4dc8 --instance-ids i-2ze7s2v0b789k60p0000 --password YourPassword --region cn-hangzhou
